prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-mrrshan-audience.png. Requested dimensions 1920x1080, 16:9. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
2 · Mrrshan — Fierias — amber / orange
Game role: gunnery masters, bad diplomats. Strengths: deadliest shooters (ships hit far more often, act first), cheap weapon research. Weaknesses: poor engineers (construction costs more), prickly — five races start uneasy, the Alkari hate them.
Body & dress: big feline predators (lion/tiger anatomy: mane-ruff, tabby stripes, whiskers, amber slit eyes), digitigrade, powerful shoulders, expressive ears and tail. Dark gunmetal gunnery-officer jackets with brass fittings; ceremonial sashes, claw-guards, kill-tally tassels. Proud, theatrical.
Surroundings: open-plan hunting-lodge architecture on a ship or palace: tiered gunnery decks, trophy walls of targeting scopes and old weapon barrels, sun-warmed stone and brass, long sightlines (they like seeing prey/targets from a distance), dust motes in amber light.
Personality: arrogant, honour-bound, restless; respects marksmanship. Moods: lazy-predatory calm → insulted fury.
Hooks: gun-cleaning rituals, a fine rifle as a diplomatic "gift", scorched trophies from the Alkari war.
Asset purpose: Diplomacy audience background. Create an imposing seat of power: audience hall, throne-office or war room derived from the race surroundings, with spatial depth and homeworld atmosphere.
Composition: No foreground characters: the game composites its existing leader portrait separately. Keep left 45% and bottom 30% dark and calm; architecture, windows, light and visual interest at centre-right.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
